2609.29913.title: MILO: Efficient Many-shot In-Context Learning with Block-wise Low-rank Compression
2609.29913.paper_summary: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to complex tasks by conditioning on thousands of demonstration examples, but this paradigm shifts the inference efficiency bottleneck to the key-value (KV) cache memory. Due to the linear scaling behavior of the KV cache, storing these intermediate tensors has become a paramount challenge for both online serving and on-device deployment. To address this issue, we propose a novel compression framework, termed MILO, that exploits the low-rank redundancy inherent in many-shot contexts. Specifically, MILO features a block-wise low-rank compression strategy that compresses the KV cache at the block granularity, where each block contains multiple many-shot examples. Furthermore, to handle the heterogeneous context density across different blocks, MILO dynamically allocates rank budgets based on the information entropy, preserving the fidelity of critical blocks while aggressively compressing redundant ones. Experimental results on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 50% reduction in KV cache memory and 1.8x throughput improvement, with negligible performance degradation on classification and reasoning benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior baselines.
2609.29913.paper_summary_zh: 許多示例的上下文學習（ICL）使大型語言模型（LLMs）能夠通過依賴數千個示範示例來適應複雜任務，但這一範式將推理效率瓶頸轉移到了鍵值（KV）快取記憶體。由於KV快取的線性擴展行為，儲存這些中間張量已成為在線服務和設備部署的主要挑戰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種新穎的壓縮框架，稱為MILO，該框架利用了許多示例上下文中固有的低秩冗餘。具體而言，MILO具有一種區塊式低秩壓縮策略，按區塊粒度壓縮KV快取，其中每個區塊包含多個許多示例。 此外，為了處理不同區塊之間的異質上下文密度，MILO根據信息熵動態分配秩預算，保留關鍵區塊的保真度，同時積極壓縮冗餘區塊。在Qwen2.5模型上的實驗結果表明，我們的方法在KV快取記憶體上達到了高達50%的減少，並且吞吐量提高了1.8倍，對分類和推理基準的性能降級微乎其微，顯著超越了先前的基準。
